soft.description: Low lift for resting cards. Derived from primary/10 (#0D2C2B), 12% opacity; X 0, Y 2, blur 8, spread 0. Colour is stored as RGBA; palette changes require updating this effect style.

medium.description: Raised menus and popovers. Derived from primary/10 (#0D2C2B), 16% opacity; X 0, Y 6, blur 16, spread 0. Colour is stored as RGBA; palette changes require updating this effect style.

hard.description: Strong lift for floating dialogs; use sparingly. Derived from primary/10 (#0D2C2B), 24% opacity; X 0, Y 10, blur 16, spread 0. Hard is relative to the other two styles, not a zero-blur shadow. Colour is stored as RGBA; palette changes require updating this effect style.

source.description: Owner-approved brand source. This is separate from the generated primary tone 40.
